## Overview Add `ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON`, a subclass of `ROCM_AITER_FA` that runs single-token decodes on AITER's gluon paged attention (`pa_decode_gluon`) under the shuffle KV-cache layout, for head-size-256 attention with GQA group 6 (the full-attention layers of Qwen3.5 / 3.6 / 3.8-27B). Everything else (prefill, multi-token decodes, other head configs) runs the parent backend unchanged. #54805 reverted the earlier in-place gluon decode in `ROCM_AITER_FA` (#52849) because ragged speculative-decode batches broke it. This PR keeps `ROCM_AITER_FA` as it is and takes the gluon path only when every decode in the batch is one token. Needs no AITER change. ## Claims - Decode attention per call, Qwen3.8-27B TP1, against main's default backend (`ROCM_ATTN`, plain KV layout): **123.0 → 17.1 µs at c4, 153.8 → 61.8 µs at c64** (`kernel_paged_attention_2d` → gluon `paged_attention_decode_sliding_window` + its split reduce). - Serving, against main's default: **+8.9 to +21.5% total tok/s and −9.2 to −17.9% mean TPOT at c4–c64**; GSM8K unchanged. This is what a user gets by turning on `VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=1`. Main has no shuffle-layout baseline for this model (`ROCM_AITER_FA` refuses the hybrid page layout). - No change for other models, platforms, KV-cache dtypes or layouts, or for runs on more than one GPU (TP, PP, PCP) or with expert parallelism. A user-selected `--attention-backend` always wins over the config hook. Before: After: ## Validation ### Serving MI355X, Qwen3.8-27B BF16, TP1, 1024×1024, greedy runs, one run per cell. Same image, container and AITER build in every arm. | Arm | vLLM | AITER | Env | Attention backend (decode kernel) | |--|--|--|--|--| | Before | main | v0.1.27 | `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1` | `ROCM_ATTN`, selected by default (`kernel_paged_attention_2d`) | | After | main + this PR | v0.1.27 | `VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=1` | `ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON`, selected by the config hook (gluon `paged_attention_decode_sliding_window`) | | Concurrency | Total tok/s Before | After | Δ | Mean TPOT (ms) Before | After | Δ | Mean TTFT (ms) Before | After | Δ | |--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:|--:| | 4 | 556.0 | 675.3 | +21.5% | 14.21 | 11.67 | −17.9% | 194.2 | 190.1 | −2.1% | | 16 | 2,021.2 | 2,350.4 | +16.3% | 15.30 | 13.05 | −14.7% | 551.4 | 583.8 | +5.9% | | 32 | 3,360.2 | 3,864.0 | +15.0% | 18.16 | 15.66 | −13.7% | 924.3 | 935.6 | +1.2% | | 64 | 5,507.1 | 5,999.1 | +8.9% | 22.14 | 20.11 | −9.2% | 1,140.4 | 1,264.3 | +10.9% | **Where the gain comes from.** There is no shuffle-layout baseline on main for this model: `--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA` with `VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=1` fails at engine start on Qwen3.8 (`AssertionError: paged_attention_common needs the K/V sides as dense planes; the resolved KV cache layout interleaves them within a block`). | Arm | GSM8K (5-shot, n = 1319) | |--|--:| | Before | 0.7278 | | After | 0.7301 | ### Reproduction ```bash # Server, Before (main, default backend ROCM_ATTN, plain KV layout) VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \ --tensor-parallel-size 1 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --kv-cache-dtype auto \ --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --no-enable-prefix-caching \ --async-scheduling -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True \ --language-model-only # Server, After (this PR; the config hook selects ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON) VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \ --tensor-parallel-size 1 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --kv-cache-dtype auto \ --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --no-enable-prefix-caching \ --async-scheduling -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True \ --language-model-only # Server, Before (main, ROCM_AITER_FA backend, shuffle KV layout): VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER=1 VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT=1 vllm serve Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B \ --tensor-parallel-size 1 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.9 --kv-cache-dtype auto \ --max-model-len 262144 --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --no-enable-prefix-caching \ --async-scheduling -cc.use_inductor_graph_partition=True \ --language-model-only --attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA # Bench vllm bench serve --backend vllm --model Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B --endpoint /v1/completions \ --dataset-name random --random-input-len 1024 --random-output-len 1024 --random-range-ratio 0.0 \ --ignore-eos --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 --num-prompts $((10 * C)) --max-concurrency $C # GSM8K lm_eval --model local-completions \ --model_args model=Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B,base_url=http://127.0.0.1:8000/v1/completions,num_concurrent=64,max_retries=3,tokenized_requests=False \ --tasks gsm8k --num_fewshot 5 --seed 1234 # Unit test pytest tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon.py ``` ### Tests - `tests/kernels/attention/test_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon.py` (ROCm only): 14 cases; 10/10 passed on 8b4526704f, the 4 newer cases TBD. - `test_pa_gluon_supports`: which head configs and KV caches take the gluon decode. Pure Python, no AITER needed. - `test_qwen3_5_config_selects_gluon_backend` (gfx950): the hook selects the backend only for the supported shape with the shuffle layout on a single GPU without expert parallelism, and never overrides a user-selected backend. - `test_gluon_decode_matches_reference` (gfx950, skipped without AITER's gluon module): a 24 q / 4 kv head, head-256 layer on the shuffle cache with 16-token blocks, ragged decode lengths (17, 100, 333, 1,100 and 1, 2,048 tokens), block-table padding pointing at block 0, and block 0 filled with NaN. It checks that `build()` zeroes block 0, that the gluon kernel runs, and that the output matches a float32 torch reference (atol/rtol 2e-2). Removing the zeroing or transposing the 5-D K/V views fails it. ## Details - `rocm_aiter_fa.py`: the shuffle-layout decode branch moves unchanged into `AiterFlashAttentionImpl._decode_shuffle_layout`, the one step the subclass overrides. - `rocm_aiter_fa_gluon.py` (new): `_decode_shuffle_layout` calls `pa_decode_gluon` (`ps=True`, `get_recommended_splits`, 128-token context partitions), imported inside the method like the parent backend's AITER imports, so the module and `pa_gluon_supports` import without AITER. It falls back to the parent decode for multi-token decodes, other block sizes and layers that `pa_gluon_supports` rejects. - The backend pins kernel blocks to 16 tokens, which the hybrid KV manager's pages split into. 128-token partitions give the kernel occupancy 2 (256 gives occupancy 1). - The gluon kernel reads V rows of the null block (block 0) for masked positions, so the metadata builder zeroes block 0 of the gluon layers on every step with decodes (one `torch._foreach_zero_`). - `Qwen3_5ForConditionalGenerationConfig.verify_and_update_config` selects the backend when no backend was chosen, the run uses one GPU (`world_size == 1`, so TP 1 and therefore DCP 1) without expert parallelism, AITER MHA and the shuffle layout are enabled, the GPU is gfx950, and `pa_gluon_supports` holds for the head counts. It logs the choice once and names the opt-out (`--attention-backend ROCM_AITER_FA`); without that line, the backend-selection log reports it as "selected via --attention-backend". ---
Pull Request Checklist - [x] I used vLLM's `/pr-checklist` skill. (Mandatory for agents, optional for humans). - [x] AI assistance was used during the creation of this PR. - [x] **Design Fit:** Minimizes impact on core components, reuses existing functionality, and justifies added complexity. - [ ] **Testing and Validation:** Validates the change and ensures any added tests are meaningful and reliable, with CI coverage or documented CI resource constraints and validation performed outside CI. - [x] **Code Quality and Style:** Keeps code and comments clear and concise, and updates relevant documentation and examples. - [ ] **Pull Request Contents:** Includes a brief summary and relevant links, supports claims with evidence, explains root causes and implementation trade-offs, and follows the contributing guide.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON: which layers it decodes on gluon, and when the Qwen3.5
+config hook selects it."""
+
+import importlib
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_rocm(), reason="ROCm-specific tests"
+)
+
+
+def _reload_envs():
+    import vllm.envs as envs
+
+    return importlib.reload(envs)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def aiter_env(monkeypatch):
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+
+    def apply(shuffle: bool) -> None:
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER", "1")
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_USE_AITER_MHA", "1")
+        monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ROCM_SHUFFLE_KV_CACHE_LAYOUT", "1" if shuffle else "0")
+        _reload_envs()
+        rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+
+    yield apply
+    monkeypatch.undo()
+    _reload_envs()
+    rocm_aiter_ops.refresh_env_variables()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("num_heads", "num_kv_heads", "head_size", "kv_cache_dtype", "shuffle", "expected"),
+    [
+        (24, 4, 256, "auto", True, True),
+        (24, 4, 256, "auto", False, False),
+        (24, 4, 256, "fp8", True, False),
+        (16, 2, 256, "auto", True, False),
+        (32, 8, 128, "auto", True, False),
+    ],
+    ids=["qwen38", "plain-kv", "fp8-kv", "gqa-8", "head-128"],
+)
+def test_pa_gluon_supports(
+    num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_size, kv_cache_dtype, shuffle, expected, aiter_env
+):
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa_gluon import pa_gluon_supports
+
+    aiter_env(shuffle)
+    assert (
+        pa_gluon_supports(num_heads, num_kv_heads, head_size, kv_cache_dtype)
+        is expected
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("backend", "heads", "kv_cache_dtype", "shuffle", "parallel", "expected"),
+    [
+        (None, (24, 4), "auto", True, (1, False), "ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON"),
+        (None, (24, 4), "auto", False, (1, False), None),
+        ("ROCM_ATTN", (24, 4), "auto", True, (1, False), "ROCM_ATTN"),
+        (None, (16, 2), "auto", True, (1, False), None),
+        (None, (24, 4), "fp8", True, (1, False), None),
+        (None, (24, 4), "auto", True, (2, False), None),
+        (None, (24, 4), "auto", True, (1, True), None),
+    ],
+    ids=["qwen38", "plain-kv", "user-backend", "gqa-8", "fp8-kv", "tp2", "ep"],
+)
+def test_qwen3_5_config_selects_gluon_backend(
+    backend, heads, kv_cache_dtype, shuffle, parallel, expected, aiter_env
+):
+    from vllm.config import AttentionConfig
+    from vllm.model_executor.models.config import _default_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+
+    if not on_gfx950():
+        pytest.skip("gfx950 only")
+    aiter_env(shuffle)
+    config = SimpleNamespace(
+        attention_config=AttentionConfig(
+            backend=AttentionBackendEnum[backend] if backend else None
+        ),
+        model_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            get_num_attention_heads=lambda _: heads[0],
+            get_num_kv_heads=lambda _: heads[1],
+            get_head_size=lambda: 256,
+        ),
+        parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(
+            world_size=parallel[0], enable_expert_parallel=parallel[1]
+        ),
+        cache_config=SimpleNamespace(cache_dtype=kv_cache_dtype),
+    )
+    _default_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon(config)
+    chosen = config.attention_config.backend
+    assert (chosen.name if chosen else None) == expected

@@ -1025,6 +1025,41 @@ class Qwen3VLForSequenceClassificationConfig(Qwen3ForSequenceClassificationConfi
     pass
 
 
+def _default_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:
+    """Default supported full-attention layers to ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON on gfx950."""
+    from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+    if not current_platform.is_rocm():
+        return
+
+    from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+    from vllm.platforms.rocm import on_gfx950
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.registry import AttentionBackendEnum
+
+    attention_config = vllm_config.attention_config
+    parallel_config = vllm_config.parallel_config
+    if (
+        attention_config.backend is not None
+        or attention_config.backend_per_kind
+        or parallel_config.world_size != 1
+        or parallel_config.enable_expert_parallel
+        or not rocm_aiter_ops.is_mha_enabled()
+        or not on_gfx950()
+    ):
+        return
+
+    from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa_gluon import pa_gluon_supports
+
+    model_config = vllm_config.model_config
+    if pa_gluon_supports(
+        model_config.get_num_attention_heads(parallel_config),
+        model_config.get_num_kv_heads(parallel_config),
+        model_config.get_head_size(),
+        vllm_config.cache_config.cache_dtype,
+    ):
+        attention_config.backend = AttentionBackendEnum.ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON
+
+
 class Qwen3_5ForConditionalGenerationConfig(VerifyAndUpdateConfig):
     @staticmethod
     def verify_and_update_config(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:
@@ -1050,6 +1085,7 @@ def verify_and_update_config(vllm_config: "VllmConfig") -> None:
                 mamba_ssm_dtype,
                 cache_config.mamba_ssm_cache_dtype,
             )
+        _default_rocm_aiter_fa_gluon(vllm_config)
 
 
 class Qwen3_5ForCausalLMConfig(Qwen3_5ForConditionalGenerationConfig):

@@ -63,6 +63,9 @@ class AttentionBackendEnum(Enum, metaclass=_AttentionBackendEnumMeta):
     ROCM_AITER_FA = (
         "vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa.AiterFlashAttentionBackend"
     )
+    ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON = (
+        "vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa_gluon.AiterFlashAttentionGluonBackend"
+    )
     ROCM_AITER_MLA_SPARSE = (
         "vllm.v1.attention.backends.mla.rocm_aiter_mla_sparse.ROCMAiterMLASparseBackend"
     )

@@ -1535,68 +1535,15 @@ def forward(
                     v_descale=v_descale,
                 )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""ROCM_AITER_FA with single-token decodes on AITER's gluon paged attention."""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm._aiter_ops import rocm_aiter_ops
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig, get_layers_from_vllm_config
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.attention import Attention
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.v1.attention.backend import CommonAttentionMetadata, MultipleOf
+from vllm.v1.attention.backends.rocm_aiter_fa import (
+    AiterFlashAttentionBackend,
+    AiterFlashAttentionImpl,
+    AiterFlashAttentionMetadata,
+    AiterFlashAttentionMetadataBuilder,
+)
+from vllm.v1.kv_cache_interface import AttentionSpec, is_quantized_kv_cache
+
+_HEAD_SIZE = 256
+_QUERY_GROUP_SIZES = (6,)
+_BLOCK_SIZE = 16
+_CONTEXT_PARTITION_SIZE = 128
+
+if current_platform.is_rocm():
+    from aiter.ops.triton.gluon.pa_decode_gluon import (
+        get_recommended_splits,
+        pa_decode_gluon,
+    )
+
+
+def pa_gluon_supports(
+    num_heads_q: int, num_heads_kv: int, head_size: int, kv_cache_dtype: str
+) -> bool:
+    """Whether a layer's head config and KV cache can use the gluon decode."""
+    return (
+        rocm_aiter_ops.is_shuffle_kv_cache_enabled()
+        and num_heads_kv > 0
+        and num_heads_q % num_heads_kv == 0
+        and num_heads_q // num_heads_kv in _QUERY_GROUP_SIZES
+        and head_size == _HEAD_SIZE
+        and not is_quantized_kv_cache(kv_cache_dtype)
+    )
+
+
+class AiterFlashAttentionGluonBackend(AiterFlashAttentionBackend):
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_supported_kernel_block_sizes(kv_cache_spec=None) -> list[int | MultipleOf]:
+        return [_BLOCK_SIZE]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_impl_cls() -> type["AiterFlashAttentionGluonImpl"]:
+        return AiterFlashAttentionGluonImpl
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_builder_cls() -> type["AiterFlashAttentionGluonMetadataBuilder"]:
+        return AiterFlashAttentionGluonMetadataBuilder
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def get_name() -> str:
+        return "ROCM_AITER_FA_GLUON"
+
+
+class AiterFlashAttentionGluonMetadataBuilder(AiterFlashAttentionMetadataBuilder):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        kv_cache_spec: AttentionSpec,
+        layer_names: list[str],
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(kv_cache_spec, layer_names, vllm_config, device)
+        layers = get_layers_from_vllm_config(vllm_config, Attention)
+        self._gluon_layers = [
+            layers[name]
+            for name in layer_names
+            if name in layers and getattr(layers[name].impl, "use_gluon_decode", False)
+        ]
+
+    def _zero_null_block(self) -> None:
+        """Zero the null block: the gluon kernel reads masked V rows."""
+        blocks = [
+            layer.kv_cache[0]
+            for layer in self._gluon_layers
+            if isinstance(layer.kv_cache, torch.Tensor) and layer.kv_cache.numel() > 0
+        ]
+        if blocks:
+            torch._foreach_zero_(blocks)
+
+    def build(
+        self,
+        common_prefix_len: int,
+        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+        fast_build: bool = False,
+    ) -> AiterFlashAttentionMetadata:
+        metadata = super().build(common_prefix_len, common_attn_metadata, fast_build)
+        if metadata.num_decodes > 0:
+            self._zero_null_block()
+        return metadata
+
+    def build_for_drafting(
+        self,
+        common_attn_metadata: CommonAttentionMetadata,
+        draft_index: int,
+    ) -> AiterFlashAttentionMetadata:
+        self._zero_null_block()
+        return super().build_for_drafting(common_attn_metadata, draft_index)
+
+
+class AiterFlashAttentionGluonImpl(AiterFlashAttentionImpl):
+    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs) -> None:
+        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
+        self.use_gluon_decode = (
+            pa_gluon_supports(
+                self.num_heads, self.num_kv_heads, self.head_size, self.kv_cache_dtype
+            )
+            and self.sliding_window[0] == -1
+            and self.sinks is None
+            and self.alibi_slopes is None
+        )
+
+    def _decode_shuffle_layout(
+        self,
+        layer: torch.nn.Module,
+        query: torch.Tensor,
+        key_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        value_cache: torch.Tensor,
+        output: torch.Tensor,
+        attn_metadata: AiterFlashAttentionMetadata,
+        num_decodes: int,
+        num_decode_tokens: int,
+    ) -> None:
+        num_blocks, block_size, num_kv_heads, head_size = key_cache.shape
+        if (
+            not self.use_gluon_decode
+            or block_size != _BLOCK_SIZE
+            or num_decode_tokens != num_decodes
+        ):
+            super()._decode_shuffle_layout(
+                layer,
+                query,
+                key_cache,
+                value_cache,
+                output,
+                attn_metadata,
+                num_decodes,
+                num_decode_tokens,
+            )
+            return
+        num_heads = query.shape[1]
+        x = 16 // key_cache.element_size()
+        splits = get_recommended_splits(num_decodes, num_kv_heads)
+        partial_shape = (num_decodes, num_kv_heads, splits, num_heads // num_kv_heads)
+        exp_sums = torch.empty(partial_shape, dtype=torch.float32, device=query.device)
+        pa_decode_gluon(
+            output=output[:num_decode_tokens],
+            query=query[:num_decode_tokens],
+            key_cache=key_cache.reshape(
+                num_blocks, num_kv_heads, head_size // x, block_size, x
+            ),
+            value_cache=value_cache.reshape(
+                num_blocks, num_kv_heads, block_size // x, head_size, x
+            ),
+            context_lengths=attn_metadata.seq_lens[:num_decodes].to(torch.int32),
+            block_tables=attn_metadata.block_table[:num_decodes].to(torch.int32),
+            softmax_scale=self.scale,
+            query_length=1,
+            max_context_partition_num=splits,
+            context_partition_size=_CONTEXT_PARTITION_SIZE,
+            compute_type=query.dtype,
+            query_scale=None,
+            key_scale=None,
+            value_scale=None,
+            exp_sums=exp_sums,
+            max_logits=torch.empty_like(exp_sums),
+            temporary_output=torch.empty(
+                (*partial_shape, head_size), dtype=output.dtype, device=query.device
+            ),
+            alibi_slopes=None,
+            sinks=None,
+            sliding_window=0,
+            ps=True,
+        )
